Face: `.claude/**` is a governed-register row (AGENTS.md Tier S) ⇒ the rules face, `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` (`dispatch-gates --tier` names no path mandate for `references/**` — that is the dev's tier, not the review's; the review face is read off the committed tree). Served at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`. The seat records; it does not approve, ready, queue or merge.

### ① Derived judgments

- **The rule is stated once, where both readers read it.** Card: before any message that names a PR as awaiting the maintainer, re-read its live state in the same act — reviews, merged/state, draft, auto_merge, queue membership — and drop or restate every PR whose ask is already met; one home, read by seats and coordinator alike. Head `coordinator.md:48` 「向维护者报任一 PR 状态前同轮重读:merged、draft、auto_merge、在队、reviews、`mergeable_state`」 under §7, whose header says 「coordinator 与席位线程皆读」; SKILL.md untouched; no second copy (`git grep` on the head for the rule's words: this line only).
- **Both directions, and the measured case.** The old L49 bound only the 「无需你做」 direction and only `mergeable_state`; the new line binds any state report. L49 「无 APPROVED 也可能已被 ready 入队 ⇒ ⛔ 单读 reviews;已办即删」 pins the case the card measured (#26661 readied and queued while the seat's list still said "waiting on you") so a reviews-only read cannot pass as the re-read. 「已办即删」 is the card's "drop"; "restate" is the remainder of reporting and needs no word of its own.
- **`dirty` handling kept.** 「`dirty` ⇒ 退回线程先合 main」 keeps the old line's one rule; 「⛔ 不转述」 is implied by the send-back and already lives in `landing-operations.md:75` (every look before a report re-reads checks and `mergeable_state`). No rule lost.
- **The deleted L48 has its homes.** 「只在结果、阻塞或待裁决时向维护者汇报,与席位同规;例行进展进线程清单」: the "what is pushed / what is not" pair stands at `SKILL.md:273–274` (受管 PR 待批合、决策卡待字、发版、仅其可解之阻 ⇒ push; 例行进展…不推), and "routine progress goes to the thread checklist, no per-round chat table" at `seat-lifecycle.md:69` (项目席轮报 = 卡线程清单,⛔ 不逐轮发聊天表). The deleted line called itself 「与席位同规」 — it was the seats' rule restated for the coordinator, and §7's header already makes the seats' rules the coordinator's. Option A (cut L48, keep the language line) is the right cut: the language line's homes (AGENTS.md Communication, SKILL.md invariant) are outside this file too, but L48 was the pure restatement.
- **Readings named, not copied.** 「在队」 and `auto_merge` point at `platform-readings.md:10/13/44` (timeline enqueue events as the decisive reading, `auto_merge` as unstable, queue-ref probes) — the skill's one home for those readings; the new line does not re-spell them. Right under the skill's no-second-copy rule.
- **Budget:** 49 → 49 lines (ceiling 49), new lines 118 B / 118 B under the 120-byte cap; no other line re-wrapped.

### ② Semver level

`.claude/**` only; `skip-changeset`; `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` in the body. No level owed. Correct.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Governed path (`.claude/**`, Tier S): `os-zhuang` APPROVED at `d8594255` — a `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` word is on the head. This seat's account is not one; this record is not an approval. With this PASS record on the head and green checks, the Tier S condition is met; ready/queue stay with the lane seat.
- Check runs on `d8594255`: 23 `success` (incl. `Lint · repo & tooling gates` — `check:pm-skill-ratchet`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint` — `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, the PR-body guards, `Test Core`, `Test UI`), 22 expected skips, 1 `in_progress` (`Lint · scoped · query-options erasure`, no `.claude` surface). Nothing red.
- Dev deviation (which line to cut, A vs the language line): judged above, A stands. Body's `Fixes #26675` on the third line under the attribution block — the closing-target guard is green, so the keyword is read.
- One thing the rule does not say and should not: it does not make a PR-event subscription the reading (the card's point) — 「同轮重读」 is the reading, and a subscription remains only a wake.

### ④ Design judgment

- `coordinator.md:48–49` against the scenario the card is accepted against — the coordinator or a seat about to tell the maintainer "these PRs wait on you": the two lines force one fresh read per PR of the six fields that decide whether the ask is already met, name the trap that produced today's misreport (ready + queued with no APPROVED), and route the one state that must not be relayed (`dirty`) back to the thread. Each field named is one the platform exposes and the skill already knows how to read; nothing is asked that a seat cannot do in one act. Holds; nothing to break.
